name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
summary: 赛博朋克动作 Roguelite：玩家扮演被判死刑的合成人，在无尽重置中组合武器、芯片与义体，杀穿机械生物并追查循环真相。本次核查未发现生成式 AI 使用证据：Steam 商店页无 AI 生成内容披露，公开报道与发行商项目页也未见相关声明。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整页面，确认没有 AI 生成内容披露栏；英文讨论区首页 15 个主题（总数 165），没有与 AI 使用相关的主题。本款单独检索 2 次、登记 24 条结果，读取 4 篇原始来源（MonsterVine 试玩报道、Games Press 官方新闻稿、IGN 前瞻、发行商 Spiral Up Games 项目页），均未提及生成式 AI。发售日期尚未公布，核查时尚未发售。八个领域均标为“未提及”。

english.summary: A cyberpunk action roguelite in which a condemned Synthetic fights through endless resets, combining weapons, chips and augments against mechanical creatures. This review found no evidence of generative AI use: the Steam store page carries no AI disclosure and no related statement appeared in press coverage or on the publisher project page.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam store page and confirmed there is no AI-generated content disclosure; the English discussion homepage showed 15 topics (165 total) with none about AI use. This title was searched twice with 24 results logged and four raw sources read (MonsterVine hands-on, Games Press release, IGN preview, Spiral Up Games project page), none of which mention generative AI. No release date has been announced and the game was unreleased at review time. All eight areas are marked as not stated.
